field_descriptions.genre: Genre of the creative work, broadcast channel or group.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.music_group_member: A member of a music group—for example, John, Paul, George, or Ringo.
field_descriptions.track: A music recording (track)—usually a single song. If an ItemList is given, the list should contain items of type MusicRecording.
field_descriptions.tracks: A music recording (track)—usually a single song.
